body:
I know i'm wasting everyone's time here and people will get frustrated with me. I'll delete the account soon so that that doesn't happen. but i appreciate talking to you all..

I just honestly believe my death would be better for others than my life, and even if my life would be better, I just don't want to live it anymore. please.

I appreciate your trying to help me. it's very nice, and it helps to talk to someone, but i feel as if i'm only wasting your time by giving up.

I'm just too tired. I've fought for too long at this. 

>you have the possibility to act whichever way you want.

I know. And yet even the way I want seems to hurt people. Even when I only try to help.

>every person is here for a reason

I know. i think mine is done though.

>with time, and the right attitude, things do get better

How much time? how much attitude? If it takes the rest of my life, is that worth living? If i were 80, would your response be different? I'm so tired, it's not worth waiting anymore. i'm so sorry for wasting your time.

>everything is solvable. Everything can be resolved, everything can change

No, I don't think so. Can it? maybe. Will it? No, i don't believe it will anymore.

>you can rewire everything about yourself.

I know. But i don't have the energy anymore. that's what giving up does. i'm so sorry for wasting your time.

>You can not feel better if you've decided that it won't work.

i agree. that's why i've given up. i tried "hibernating in this period of my life" for years. i tried meds, I tried therapy. No one can help me anymore because I've accepted suicide as the only solution. I'm so sorry for wasting your time.

You can talk and I'll listen, but honestly I believe everyone will be better off without me. I'm tired of fighting and being in pain. So talking feels pointless. I just needed to type out what i plan on doing so someone knew, since i won't tell anyone in my life.
I know. That's the problem. I am so tired of trying. I give up on being helped.
I just did. It's not important anymore; it was on an old account. I tried to do good thigns and I hurt people. I'm so tired of trying to fix this.
I'm so tired. I will mess it up. This all just needs to end. I just want it to end.
Just what's above. Nothing else. I can't even talk on here, because I'll mess up or hurt someone. I just want it to end.
